Name: Magical Witchy Kitchen and Furniture Pack
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVWAHsI.png[/img]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia]
[size=5]An Alternative Textures Pack and optional Content Patcher Kitchen Retexture for all my witchy/magical friends!

I had reached out to cometkins ages ago about their unreleased witchy furniture I saw here back in the day, and they were kind enough to share the files with me so I could create this mod for us! I turned the furniture into an AT pack and then reworked some of the assets into a witchy kitchen to match.

You can choose to use either or both; just pick which one(s) you want from the Files section. 

Includes (but not limited to)
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]cauldron[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]dried herbs[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]crystal balls[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]fruit basket[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]fancy couches[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]witchy recolored tables[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]placeable bushes[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]animated fountains[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]flower boxes[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]mushroom lamps and wall sconces[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]fireplaces[/size][/font]
[/list]

A big thank you to the SDV modding discord community for their continued love and support and friendship <3[/size][/font][font=Georgia][i][size=5]
